test_title: PYST 1: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in passive voice.

I was carrying the Indian flag.

options.text: The Indian flag is being carried by me.
The Indian flag were being carried by me.
The Indian flag had being carried by me.
The Indian flag was being carried by me.

solution:
The correct answer is **''The Indian flag was being carried by me.''**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **past continuous tense**, which describes actions that were in progress in the past.
 
• The structure of past continuous tense is given below:
 
 
• **Active voice sentence structure**: *"Sub + was/were + V1+ing + object."*
 
 
• **Example**: *I was watching the movie*.
 
 
 
• **Passive voice sentence structure**:* "Object of active voice (subjective case) + was/were + being + V3 + by + Subject of active voice (objective case)."*
 
 
• **Example**: *The movie was being watched by me.*
 
 
 
 
 
• Following above structure, we get the correct **passive voice**: **"The Indian flag was being carried by me."**

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When we convert **active voice** to **passive voice**, three things need to be kept in mind:

 
 
• Change **object** into **subject**.
 
• Change **subject **into **object**.
 
• Always use the **third form of verb** in the passive voice.
 
• Use** 'by'** before the new object.
